name: daily-ai-brief-cost-haiku-5-5-source-urls-capped-candidate
description: 2026-10-17 cost mitigation arm (ADR-0018 D8): identical to haiku-5-5-source-urls -- same model/effort/system prompt/skill pin, and the same task-prompt.md carrying the generated curated-source-URL block -- except that the agent toolset caps web_fetch page content at max_content_tokens 8000, so a large RSS feed can no longer land ~25K tokens of context in one fetch.
